mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, txn_date, description, category, amount, currency, source_file) VALUES (#{userId}, #{txnDate}, #{description}, #{category}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{sourceFile})

INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, txn_date, description, category, amount, currency, source_file) VALUES
(#{t.userId}, #{t.txnDate}, #{t.description}, #{t.category}, #{t.amount}, #{t.currency}, #{t.sourceFile})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, txn_date, description, category, amount, currency, source_file, created_at FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY txn_date DESC, id DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(txn_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND txn_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(txn_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM transactions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
